title: Michael's strange sightings in Missouri, the Ozarks and Texas

tellings.quote: I have seen strange occurrences in Missouri, in the Ozarks,

plain: A former Air Force airman named Michael Johnson, who says he was abducted by aliens while stationed in South Dakota, tells Michels he has also seen "strange occurrences" in Missouri, in the Ozarks and in Texas. He mentions them in passing, without describing what he saw, as a sign that the strange events in his life did not stop with the base.
